title: Nilicheadha Neesaakhigaa – Elijah Evangeline Telugu Christian Lyrics

నాకోసం నీవే నీకోసం నేనే మనసంతా నీవే బ్రతుకంతా నీకే

english: Nee vanti varu leru naa yesayya,
Na thodu neeve kadha naa yesayya,
Na kosam nevve, nee kosam nene
Cheraanu ninnu deva, nilichaavu naaku sadha
Mugisina naadhu kadha, cheasaavu goppa kaddha
Cheasaavu nannu neevu dhaachaavu nannu neelo
Vinnaanu needhu swaram pondhaanu goppa varam
intro: Nilicheadha Neesaakhigaa is the latest Telugu Christian song is written & tuned by Swarna, sung by Elijah Evangeline and music composed by Prasanth Penumaka. The official music video for Nilicheadha Neesaakhigaa premiered on September 27, 2025, via his official YouTube channel Choice of New Life.
